name: Our Speech
overview: Scripture emphasizes the profound impact of our speech, illustrating that the tongue holds the power of life and death, and those who love to speak will bear its consequences. Believers are urged to guard their words carefully, as a soft answer can defuse anger, while harsh words provoke strife. The Bible portrays wholesome speech as healing and life-giving, likening it to a tree of life and sweet honeycomb that nourishes the soul and body. Wisdom is also demonstrated in restraint, with even a fool gaining respect by holding their peace and controlling their lips.
